parameters.scope: Three whole-machine candidates from one common mechanism; actual physical validation remains separate

requirements.coldAirReference: preserve R3 adopted6.4m/s local-reference-as-Gaussian-peak, sigma20mm,150mm plane; not a measured product guarantee
requirements.floor: level indoor floor; adopted local height departure +/-0.3mm, not measured
requirements.budgetApproval: User explicitly approved approximately JPY24000 per machine on2026-09-28 via the coordinating parent,finishing with stock parts; includes guards,all fasteners,assembly cradles and initial fit pieces. Shipping,uncertain taxes and unowned hand tools including DN-03 approximately JPY396 are separate. No purchasing authorized.
requirements.importedPartsScope: input shaft/bearings/hub/collars and their already-counted fastener packs only

common.fixedPivotAssembly: Inboard M2 screw head reached through5.6mm counterbore with1.5mm hex key; two jam nuts outside atX62.5..65.7. No buried-nut side window and no weakened window ligaments.

guards.sideSheetOutline: lower edge follows the union of actual gear radial envelopes plus3mm; no full-width rectangle at the largest radius
guards.qualification: Real removable cage integrated with floating cap; no impact/fragment containment certification. End-grid and cylindrical-grid clear openings are at most9mm nominal outside necessary shaft/frame passages.

legJournals.loadPath: All journals use smooth4mm C6801BD sleeves. A uses20mm with3.95mm socket embed,X50.5..54.45 via an integral front boss; stationaryP uses20mm with11.5mm embed,X42.5..54,an inboard M2x25 head and two outboard jam nuts. Each has a1mm annular floor. No screw thread is a sliding surface.
legJournals.proofStatus: same actual reaction load screens plus sleeve bending,bearing pressure,screw shear/tension and printed-root acceptance required; no bolt-grade assumption based on an unverified SKU

synchronization.type: five identical external spur gears coupling three real shafts in phase
synchronization.idlerSupport: short fixed M3/sleeve axle, not a through-shaft crossing the reducer wheel
synchronization.note: Use the simpler three-shaft reference with catalogued coil feet after testing contact errors, rather than retaining unnecessary extra legs. R3 quartered rods are not silently reused where their shaft/sweep geometry conflicts.

gears.shaftClamping: positive printed5mm-AF bore with split axial boss and captured M3 bolt/nut; clamp removes axial looseness, flats carry torque

foot.type: two symmetric stock coils on one guided carriage and a two-pad equalizing rocker per leg; actual extra springs are counted,not an assumed material change
foot.laneConstruction: two8mm rolling pads and one20mm brass guide per leg. Foot centerX64.4 is the actual CEF link midplane. The guide is moved10mm rearward within that plane and lowered7mm,not cantilevered22mm outboard; both spring axes stay over the rocker. Support uses each foot center,not an enlarged polygon.
foot.rockerPinLocking: One stock M2 nylon-insert nut; not a measured holding-torque or reuse equivalent to the earlier jam-nut pair
foot.mountPlacementReason: The complete foot module is physically4mm forward in its own Y direction,without larger pads or ballast. The84mm shaft pitch is sized to clear the156-tooth output and actual shafts; the smaller foot offset avoids the excessive handoff work measured with8mm. Final actual-CAD force,COM and tolerance checks are required.
foot.stiffnessQualification: manufacturer nominal coil rate; rate tolerance and guide hysteresis are separate design envelopes,not measured. Fixed guide axis is centered on canonical stance orientation,not an airborne pose.
foot.antiBallast: no added ballast; spring travel is functional compliance, not oversized support foot

errors.note: explicit manufacturing acceptance scenarios, not guaranteed machine capability; targeted corners and seeded samples, not interval proof

criteria.functionalSwingBudget: positive separation at mid-swing must exceed two-sidedfloor departure +observed tolerance path loss +loaded spring travel. Old8mm is a design goal, not a userconstraint.
criteria.scope: conditional quasi-static compliance/rolling-contact calculation, not dynamic free walking
